title: Aether Forge Planner Output
description: Pins the JSON shape every planner emits before the runtime translates it into typed StepProposal objects. v0.23.0+ (FP-1, cross-language). The companion `docs/specs/planner-output.md` is the normative behavioral spec for the parser (preamble stripping, balanced-brace recovery, retry semantics); this file is the structural contract any Python or TypeScript planner can validate against. Both the Python `aether_forge.planner._extract_json` recovery path and the TypeScript `@aether-forge/sdk` `parsePlannerOutput` produce values conforming to this schema.

kind.description: One of the five StepKind values. Matches `aether_forge.runtime.StepKind` (Python) and `StepKind` (TypeScript).

capabilityId.description: Required when kind is `use-capability` or `request-approval`. The Python parser also accepts the snake_case alias `capability_id`.

capability_id.description: Snake-case alias of `capabilityId` for back-compat with older planners. New planners should emit `capabilityId`.

payload.description: Step-specific arguments. For `use-capability` / `request-approval`, payload is forwarded to the capability handler. For `reason` steps, payload may carry `mark_complete: true` to advance session state.
